title: Deduplicate on business key plus version window
description: Merges events using only event id even though the source reuses ids across versions.
issue_title: Deduplication key is too weak for the source semantics
issue_description: If event ids are reused across versions or retries, a one-column dedup key can collapse distinct records incorrectly.
issue_suggestion: Use the true business key and ordering/version field when deduplicating incoming events.

title: Do not partition event-time reports by ingestion date
description: Builds a fact table partitioned by when the batch arrived.
issue_title: Data layout does not match analytical time semantics
issue_description: Queries by business event time will scan the wrong partitions when ingestion lags behind event production.
issue_suggestion: Partition by event-time date when that is the primary reporting dimension.

title: Enforce monotonic watermark progression
description: Loads incrementally based on the max updated_at seen in the last batch.
code:
def next_watermark(rows):
    return max(row['updated_at'] for row in rows)
issue_title: Watermark can move backward on late or partial batches
issue_description: Using only the latest row from one batch can make incremental loading skip or duplicate changes.
issue_suggestion: Advance the watermark monotonically with a persisted checkpoint and safety overlap.

title: Avoid unbounded small-file amplification
description: Writes one parquet file per source message.
issue_description: One-file-per-message output hurts downstream scan performance and metadata overhead.
issue_suggestion: Batch records into larger output files or compact them before publishing.

title: Model slowly changing dimensions with effective windows
description: Updates the customer dimension row in place when plan changes.
code:
def apply_plan_change(customer_id, new_plan):
    warehouse.execute('UPDATE dim_customer SET plan = ? WHERE customer_id = ?', new_plan, customer_id)
issue_description: Changing the dimension in place loses the ability to analyze facts against the correct historical attributes.
issue_suggestion: Use effective start and end timestamps for dimension versions.
issue_code: INSERT INTO dim_customer (customer_id, plan, effective_from, effective_to) VALUES (...)

title: Validate metric units before combining sources
description: Adds revenue from one feed in cents and another in dollars.
code:
def total_revenue(feed_a, feed_b):
    return sum(row['amount'] for row in feed_a) + sum(row['amount'] for row in feed_b)
issue_title: Measures from different sources use incompatible units
issue_description: Combining amounts without unit normalization silently corrupts financial metrics.
issue_suggestion: Normalize all monetary values to one unit before aggregation.

title: Pre-filter huge fact joins before the shuffle
description: Joins all clickstream rows to all campaign rows before narrowing the date range.
code:
SELECT *
FROM clicks c
JOIN campaigns p ON c.campaign_id = p.id
WHERE c.event_date BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-31';
issue_title: The expensive join happens before the selective filter
issue_description: Large-scale joins should reduce data volume as early as possible to avoid excessive shuffle and compute cost.
issue_suggestion: Push partition and date filters down before the join.
issue_code: WITH filtered_clicks AS (SELECT * FROM clicks WHERE event_date BETWEEN ...)

title: Monitor null-rate drift on critical dimensions
description: Loads campaign facts without checking how many records lost attribution ids.
issue_title: Critical data quality drift is not measured
issue_description: A surge in null dimension keys can silently break reporting before anyone notices.
issue_suggestion: Emit and alert on null-rate metrics for key analytical dimensions.
issue_code: null_rate = sum(1 for row in rows if row['campaign_id'] is None) / len(rows)

title: Keep replay-safe raw zones immutable during reprocessing
description: Reruns backfills by overwriting the raw landing path.
issue_title: Raw landing data is overwritten during replay
issue_description: Mutating the raw zone destroys the original evidence needed for audit and deterministic reprocessing.
issue_suggestion: Write replay outputs into a derived zone and keep the raw landing path immutable.

title: Align CDC deletes with snapshot rebuild semantics
description: Builds a current-state table from inserts and updates, then rebuilds snapshots without tombstones.
issue_description: Current-state reconstruction will resurrect deleted entities if delete events are dropped from the replay logic.
issue_suggestion: Carry tombstones through replay and remove deleted ids during rebuild.
